reviewed_exclusions.reason: These unchanged tests fail with stock rclpy 7.1.11: the installed pybind Node rejects destruction-order's ad hoc context_handle assignment, and the stock client rejects the graph-derived TypeHash in the type-description request. They cannot provide backend evidence in this source-only gate.
Requires the upstream repository's separately built test_rclpy extension, which the source-only contract environment intentionally does not build.
